title: Viyash Scientific (VIYASH, formerly SeQuent Scientific) - LIVE deep dive #9, first IT/Healthcare-frame draw (protocol v1.4, stages 2-7): method test, no verdict; card v1.5 size 0; 6 live deep-dive calls + 3 card calls
body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): random draw (Random(20261206)) from 100 IT (38) / Healthcare (67) names (5 excluded) in the India Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band at the 25-Nov-2026 close (bhavcopy DATE1); prereg sha256 882f9b3b... written 07:06 UTC before the frame. SKIPS: DCAL (PEAD Q1, SUE -1.94, 13-Nov-2026), ZOTA (PEAD Q1, SUE -0.75, 28-Oct-2026); subject = walk #3. S2 passed: SRBC unmodified FY26 with EoM (common-control merger restatement); ICRA AA-/Stable and Ind-Ra AA- (upgrade, then withdrawn on request); pledge 0; solvency 0 flags (ICR 8.3x TTM); no FDA Import Alert 66-40 entry; SEBI administrative warning (procedural SDD lapse). PEAD Q5 (SUE +3.23) but the comparator is pre-merger SeQuent. FINDINGS: (1) identity change - SeQuent absorbed Viyash Life Sciences + Symed (common control, appointed date 1-Apr-2025, effective 16-Dec-2025), so no usable own history; (2) TTM revenue 3,712.7, EBITDA 703, owners' PAT 232.6; 43x basic / 47.6x fully diluted attributable P/E, but ~Rs 139 cr pre-tax of temporary costs (merger ESOP TTM 79.9 vs ~25 steady; acquired-intangible amortisation ~84 ending in Q3 FY27); L44 strip of exceptional (-41.3) and other income (50.0) moves P/E only 2%; (3) dilution ~9% (MD warrants 2.03 cr at Rs 181.94 + ~2.1 cr options [EST]); NCI 13-17% of PAT (40% of Appco USA and Karizoo Spain); (4) CFO's ESOP guide missed ~3x within one quarter (Aug: Q2-Q4 ~40 cr; Nov: Q2 42, FY27 ~148); (5) Carlyle sold ~12% (61.31% -> 49.24%) in Q2 FY27; (6) group ROIC ~9.9% (13.2% ex goodwill 877) vs CoE 12.5%; (7) US/Appco -11% y/y after exclusivity erosion; KSM/China share undisclosed; no customer >10%. CONSENSUS (Yahoo, 4 analysts, 26-Nov-2026): FY27 EPS 7.43, FY28 11.83 (19.4x) vs our bottom-up ~7.35 / ~11.3 basic (10.3 diluted) - agreement on near-term EPS; consensus possibly on the company's 'adjusted' ESOP basis. NEWS: 55 items/17 material, BioForLife confirmed (Reg-30, stale resurfacing), capex Rs 150-170 cr confirmed, PAT +38.7% vs +16.1% headlines = owners vs group lines. VALUATION: worksheet base IRR 8.4%; EV 0.97x raw / 1.07x anchored vs 1.76x hurdle -> size 0 (9 of 9 live cards); run-2 sensitivity (economic starting margin) gave 0.85x because EPS grows from the depressed base - worksheet cannot express a cost roll-off step. LESSON CANDIDATES: identity-changing-merger rule for history/PEAD; temporary-cost bridge in the worksheet; L44 extension (temporary costs separate from exceptionals); credibility on management-excluded items; NCI + dilution in the base; consensus tool retry logging.

title: An identity-changing merger in the last 2 years breaks own-history bands, ROIIC windows and PEAD comparators
body: VIYASH (dd9): SeQuent (animal health) absorbed Viyash Life Sciences + Symed under common control 11 months before the draw. The symbol's 10-yr EPS/P/E history is a different business; FY25->TTM ROIIC ~52% is a merger window; the PEAD SUE +3.23 (quintile 5) compares merged Q2 FY27 with pre-merger Q2 FY26. Candidate rule: if a scheme changed >50% of revenue in 2 years, mark own-history and PEAD 'not comparable' and use peers + restated pro-forma only.

title: L44 extension: temporary operating costs (merger ESOP, acquired-intangible amortisation) can matter more than exceptionals; the worksheet cannot step them off
body: VIYASH (dd9): L44 strip (exceptional -41.3, other income 50.0) moved P/E 2%; temporary ESOP excess (~55 cr) + ending amortisation (~84 cr) ~ Rs 2.1/share (~40% of TTM EPS). Putting them in exceptional_items_cr would double-subtract/hide a real cost; raising the starting NOPAT margin LOWERED worksheet EV (0.97x -> 0.85x) because EPS grows from base.eps. Needs a bridge input (next-2-year EPS or per-year margin override). Also: management's 'adjusted PAT' removed exactly the line it forecast worst (ESOP guide missed ~3x within a quarter) -> track guidance on excluded items as a credibility category.

title: Decision card VIYASH 2026-11-26 (paper)
body: Decision card v1 for Viyash Scientific Ltd (formerly SeQuent Scientific; human + animal-health APIs, animal-health formulations (Alivira), US human generics via 60%-owned Appco Pharma). Rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.07x anchored (raw 0.97x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Thesis: Method-test thesis: Viyash Scientific is the 16-Dec-2025 common-control merger of Carlyle's two Indian pharma holdings - SeQuent Scientific (animal-health APIs and Alivira formulations in Europe, Turkey, Brazil, India) and Viyash Life Sciences (human APIs/advanced intermediates in Hyderabad/Vizag, ex-Mylan units; Symed Labs) - plus 60%-owned Appco Pharma (US generics). TTM revenue Rs 3,713 cr (Q2 FY27: formulations 57%, APIs 42%; Europe 19%, emerging markets 21%, USA 12%, India 5% of sales), pre-ESOP EBITDA ~21%, 16 plants of which 10 USFDA-approved API sites, no customer above 10% of revenue, net debt Rs 26 cr. Reported earnings are depressed by two temporary lines: a merger ESOP charge (FY27 ~Rs 148 cr vs ~25 cr steady state) and acquired-intangible amortisation (~Rs 100 cr FY26 -> ~38 cr FY27 -> ~0). Group ROIC ~10% (13% ex goodwill) vs a 12.5% cost of equity. Variant view: Market: at Rs 228.88 (mcap Rs 10,108 cr basic; Rs 11,062 cr fully diluted for the MD's 2.03 cr warrants and ~2.1 cr ESOP options) the stock trades at 43x reported TTM EPS (5.34 basic) and 47.6x fully diluted - but 4 analysts (Yahoo, 26-Nov-2026) put FY27 EPS at 7.43 and FY28 at 11.83 (forward P/E 19.4x on FY28), i.e. the market is pricing the ESOP/amortisation roll-off plus ~20% growth. Our read: no claimable mispricing. (1) Our bottom-up FY28 EPS (~11.3 basic / ~10.3 diluted) is close to consensus, so the 'expensive on TTM' look is mostly accounting, not a mistake by the market; (2) but at ~21-22x our FY28 diluted EPS the price already needs mid-teens growth sustained with ROIIC above the 12.5% CoE, and the worksheet base case (14% fading to 8%, margin 12.5%, exit 24x) gives an 8.4% IRR and a 1.08x 5-yr multiple; (3) the CFO's own ESOP guidance missed 3x within one quarter (Aug-2026: Q2-Q4 ~Rs 40 cr total; Nov-2026: Q2 alone 42, Q2-Q4 ~122) - the cost line the 'adjusted PAT' framing removes is the one management forecast worst; (4) Carlyle (promoter) sold ~12% in Q2 FY27 (61.31% -> 49.24% SHP) in year 5-6 of its holding: a supply overhang the MD says will not recur 'in the next 12 months'. Evidence for the other side: two AA- ratings (ICRA Apr-2026; Ind-Ra upgrade from A, Apr-2026), net debt ~0, no USFDA import alert found, clean EIR at the US site, diversified customers, API revival delivered in Q2 as guided. Departure from the outside view: raw P(blow-up) 7% < class 15% (no pledge, AA-, no customer >10%) and raw P(<=0.5x) ~27% > class 11% because the entry multiple is high; default w=0.5. Checked by paper calls thesis:paper-call:VIYASH:*. Open soft flags: 4. P(≥3x) 2% vs base 21%; P(≤0.5x) 27% vs base 11.3%; EV 5-yr multiple 0.97x vs hurdle 1.76x. Review 2027-02-28.
